Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting interest and penalties on unpaid taxes if caused by participation in Operation Enduring Freedom.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to interest and penalties on unpaid taxes due toinvolvement with Operation Enduring Freedom; adding a new section tochapter 82.32 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any other provision in this chapter, nointerest or penalties may be imposed on any person because of thefailure to pay excise taxes on or before the date due for payment ifthe person establishes that: (a) The failure to pay was caused, in whole or in part, byparticipation of key employees as military personnel in the situationknown as Operation Enduring Freedom; and (b) If it were not for the participation of key employees asmilitary personnel in the situation known as Operation EnduringFreedom, the person would have been able to satisfy the payment oftaxes in a timely manner. (2) Payment of taxes shall be made within thirty days after thereturn of the key personnel. p. 1 HB 2201 (3) As used in this section, "person" means a natural person or asmall business as defined in RCW 19.85.020. (4) This section does not affect those transactions upon which adefault has occurred before participation of key employees as militarypersonnel in the situation known as Operation Enduring Freedom. (5) This section applies to excise taxes with a date due forpayment on or before July 31, 2004.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
